name: Decision Record Intelligence (deterministic typed-record producer, PB-6)
purpose: The Collective Agent's decision-record PRODUCER (D-0077 governing doc: core-docs/research/2026-08-14-pb6-decision-record-schema.md; i56 PB-6 build, the first PB-7 knowledge-surface re-layer increment, arch position 45). A stdlib-only Python worker (decision_intel.py) parses the append-only core-docs/DECISION_LOG.md (~640 KB) + core-docs/DECISION_LOG_INDEX.md routing rows and emits TYPED record_kind='decision' record-envelope artifacts conforming to core-docs/MEMORY_CONTRACT.md section 1, so the catalog (#36 artifact.search) can ingest them as FIRST-CLASS records -- the decision surface becomes losslessly-backed + typed-indexed + cold-retrievable while the hot boot surface stays bounded. Deterministic marker rules (documented in SCHEMA_NOTES.md, EVERY regex recorded) derive: binding_scope (standing_prohibition | invariant | ordinary, from FROZEN/prohibited vs never/always/inviolable/HARD markers), enforced_by (a known deterministic-gate id, else 'none'), authority (nicholas | orchestrator | gate | redteam), type, iteration, date, affected_modules, and a static documented module->plane table (a named interpretation pending real #44 project.map plane integration). Edges: full supersedes/superseded_by from DECISION_LOG_INDEX.md bracket annotations (`[superseded by D-####]` / `[folded by D-####]` / `[... retired by D-####]`) UNIONED with explicit 'supersedes/replaces D-####' declarations in DECISION_LOG.md entry bodies (handles both a compact citation shorthand 'D-0140/42/45' and a fully-repeated list 'D-0140/D-0142/D-0145'); partially_supersedes on a softer revision cue (revises/refines/amends/RE-FROZEN/reconciles/folds-into) naming a specific decision id WITHOUT a full-replacement marker (conservative -- KEEPS the predecessor status=current, per the frozen contract s8 rule 4); derives_from on cited research/*.md digests. Envelope `status` (current|superseded|folded|closed) is EDGE-DRIVEN (demotes only on a resolved full supersedes/superseded_by or folded_into edge), not merely copied from a possibly-stale index-row annotation -- a mismatch between the two is surfaced honestly as an `ambiguous` flag, never silently resolved either way. Every entry that cannot be classified deterministically (no affected-module reference found; an index-state annotation with no resolvable target; an unresolved supersession-target token) is flagged in `ambiguous`/`unresolved_supersession_targets`, never silently dropped (D-0107/D-0109 honesty discipline). Emits records.jsonl / records.json (the full MEMORY_CONTRACT s1 envelope, one canonical record per line, deterministic order), ingest_records.json (conforms EXACTLY to the #36 artifact.search `ingest_records` op INPUT shape per its SCHEMA_NOTES s4 -- record_id/record_version_id/record_kind/text/attrs/edges), index_manifest.json (counts + records_digest + validation + coverage + ambiguous list), coverage.json (every DECISION_LOG_INDEX.md row has a record; every record's source_span resolves to its canonical DECISION_LOG.md entry -- missing/extra lists must be empty), and summary.md. `ingested_through` (the DECISION_LOG.md HEAD sha for this run) is a REQUIRED CALLER-SUPPLIED input -- this worker NEVER shells out to git (mirrors #38 repo.intel's D-0072 no-git-in-worker rule); identical for every record in one run. op 'validate' re-checks an existing records artifact against the s1-adapted validator (required fields, content-derived id integrity, span-or-derivation_refs, edge-endpoint integrity, binding_scope/status enum membership). Determinism: all ids are content+path derived ('dec_<NNNN>' from the canonical D-number, stable across re-ingest); canonical JSON (sort_keys, ensure_ascii, compact separators); spans are BYTE offsets over raw DECISION_LOG.md bytes (EOL-faithful -- core-docs are CRLF); NO absolute paths/timestamps/random ids in any canonical artifact -> identical corpus content + the same ingested_through input yields byte-identical artifacts across runs AND machines (double-run byte-identity VERIFIED). CPU-only, no model, no network -> determinism=deterministic, confidence=null, empty model_provenance, NOT a review producer. This module EMITS + VALIDATES artifacts only; it does NOT write the catalog DB (#36 owns storage -- the orchestrator feeds ingest_records.json into #36 `ingest_records` at fold, mirroring the #38->#36 D-0077 pattern verbatim). Non-goals (NOT built this increment): model-generated synopses (the `synopsis` field is RESERVED null), real #44 project.map plane integration (a static documented table stands in), the 'compile the task-relevant decision set' retrieval verb (FANOUT_AGENT_002's lane, routed via #40+#37 -- no new retrieval arch), any UI, git-history parsing.

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Op index|validate (default index); -DecisionLogPath <core-docs/DECISION_LOG.md> (index); -DecisionLogIndexPath <core-docs/DECISION_LOG_INDEX.md> (index); -Namespace <label> (default 'decisions'); -IngestedThrough <sha> (index; REQUIRED, 7-40 lowercase hex, the DECISION_LOG.md HEAD sha for this run -- CALLER-supplied, this wrapper never shells out to git); -RecordsPath <records.jsonl|records.json> (validate); -PythonPath <python>; -WorkerPath <decision_intel.py>. OR the generic -InputsJson '<json {op, decision_log_path, decision_log_index_path, namespace, ingested_through, records_path, python_path, worker_path}>' (named params override matching keys). Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.description: index: the single namespace for this record class (frozen contract s1).

inputs.name: ingested_through
inputs.description: index: REQUIRED. The DECISION_LOG.md HEAD sha at this ingest (7-40 lowercase hex). Identical across all records in one run; sourced deterministically by the CALLER -- NO git in this worker.

inputs.name: records_path
inputs.description: validate: path to a records.jsonl or records.json to re-validate.

outputs.description: envelope.result = { op, namespace, total_records, record_kind:'decision', counts_by_status{current,superseded,folded,closed}, counts_by_binding_scope{standing_prohibition,invariant,ordinary}, records_digest (sha256 over sorted per-record lines; machine-independent), validation{ok,checked,error_count,errors[]}, edge_summary{total,resolved_internal,external}, coverage{index_row_count,log_entry_count,missing_records_for_index_rows[],extra_records_without_index_row[],span_resolution_ok,ok}, ambiguous_count, ambiguous[{decision_id,flags[]}], unresolved_supersession_targets[{decision_id,unresolved_targets[]}], ingest_run_id, checked (validate), runtime_ms, worker }. Artifacts (envelope.artifacts[], each path/kind/bytes/sha256; index op): records.jsonl (one canonical s1 record per line -- deterministic order), records.json (canonical array), ingest_records.json (the #36 `ingest_records` op INPUT shape per its SCHEMA_NOTES s4 -- the exact drop-in, not a re-wrap), index_manifest.json (counts + records_digest + validation + coverage + ambiguous + fingerprints), coverage.json, summary.md (human-readable: status/binding_scope counts, coverage, ambiguous flags, unresolved targets). validate: result.validation + edge_summary only (no artifacts).
